churches.assessment: First CRC Sioux Center (instituted 1891) is the oldest CRC in Sioux Center, IA — the heart of the heavily Dutch Reformed northwest Iowa belt where high school Sunday school still works through the Heidelberg Catechism and Belgic Confession. Rev. Kurt Monroe was specifically named in a 2025 American Conservative profile of the Sioux Center community ("Reformed And Unafraid") as representative of the confessional pattern. Rated YELLOW per the standing rubric for CRCNA congregations: orthodox confessional baseline is high in the Sioux Center cluster, but full staff page verification was not possible (staff directory returned 404 on live-fetch) so the denomination's drift caveat continues to apply. Needs review for a full elder slate confirmation before any upgrade to GREEN.
